Description: The FireCompass Risks solution provides real-time risk finding ingestion from the FireCompass platform into Microsoft Sentinel using the Codeless Connector Framework (CCF) Push pattern. The FireCompass platform pushes risk records (severity, state, asset, assessment context, and remediation guidance) directly to Azure Monitor for analysis, alerting, and closed-loop remediation.
